lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly equidistant vertical columns across the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An irregular, high-luminance patch on the dorsal surface anterior to the first dorsal fin.
